content.user_title: Audit Paid Ad Accounts Before Scaling
content.value_statement: Paid media teams can scale waste when reported ROAS hides attribution, safety, or measurement problems. This skill evaluates exported evidence with a typed 20-item framework and verified decision gates.
actual_capabilities: Evaluates one paid advertising account or portfolio against 20 ROAS criteria.
Supports direct-response, prospecting, and incremental-profit scoring profiles.
Normalizes currency, attribution windows, conversion lag, identifiers, and portfolio scope.
Checks measurement integrity, attribution inflation, offer compliance, placement safety, and spend efficiency.
Returns SHIP, FIX, BLOCK, or UNDECIDED guidance when required evidence supports a deterministic result.
Produces prioritized fixes, owners, evidence gaps, confidence, and rerun conditions.
limitations: Requires exported account, outcome, attribution, placement, and business constraint data.
Cannot issue a final score when required evidence or the deterministic scorer is unavailable.
Does not change campaigns, bids, audiences, budgets, or account settings.
Does not treat platform-reported ROAS as causal incrementality without supporting evidence.

use_cases.title: Pre-Scale Account Review
use_cases.description: Assess whether measurement quality and operating controls support a material budget increase.

use_cases.title: Attribution Integrity Check
use_cases.description: Compare platform reporting with deduplicated orders, leads, windows, and conversion lag.

use_cases.title: Portfolio Governance Audit
use_cases.description: Identify verified vetoes, evidence gaps, and prioritized fixes across a paid media portfolio.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Account Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this paid account for direct response. Use the attached campaign and outcome exports, then list missing required context.
prompt_templates.scenario: A first review with limited exported data

prompt_templates.title: ROAS and CAC Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this USD account using a seven-day click window, three-day conversion lag, and a 120 USD CAC ceiling.
prompt_templates.scenario: A direct-response account with declared constraints

prompt_templates.title: Attribution Reconciliation
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare platform conversions with deduplicated order IDs. Normalize windows and lag, identify inflation, and score every supported ROAS criterion.
prompt_templates.scenario: A measurement review using platform and first-party data

prompt_templates.title: Incremental Profit Gate
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the incremental-profit profile using holdout, margin, placement, claims, and change-history exports. Verify vetoes and provide owners with rerun conditions.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced scaling decision with complete evidence

output_examples.input: A complete direct-response export with a raw score of 78 and no verified vetoes.
output_examples.output: SHIP. Final score: 78. Measurement, offer, audience, and spend controls support the declared scaling decision.

output_examples.input: An account export with a raw score of 78 and one verified instrumentation failure.
output_examples.output: FIX. Final score: 59. Repair conversion instrumentation, assign an owner, and rerun after validation against first-party outcomes.

output_examples.input: Campaign data without a placement report or reconciled first-party outcomes.
output_examples.output: UNDECIDED. Required evidence is missing, so the audit reports coverage gaps and does not produce an overall score.

best_practices: Provide deduplicated first-party outcomes alongside platform exports.
Declare currency, attribution window, conversion lag, business constraint, goal, and observation date.
Use verified evidence for vetoes and keep unavailable criteria marked as unknown.
anti_patterns: Do not use platform-reported ROAS as the only truth source.
Do not convert missing evidence into a pass, failure, or inapplicable state.
Do not request campaign or budget changes as part of the audit.

faq.question: What data does this skill need?
faq.answer: Provide campaign, spend, outcome, attribution, placement, change-history, economics, and business constraint exports when available.

faq.question: Which advertising platforms are supported?
faq.answer: The framework is platform independent when exports can be normalized to the required account, outcome, and attribution evidence.

faq.question: Can it calculate a final score with missing data?
faq.answer: No. Missing required evidence remains unknown and can produce NEEDS_INPUT with an UNDECIDED verdict.

faq.question: Does it change campaigns or budgets?
faq.answer: No. It audits evidence and reports decisions without changing bids, audiences, campaigns, budgets, or account settings.

faq.question: How does it handle attribution?
faq.answer: It normalizes windows, currency, identifiers, and lag before comparing platform results with deduplicated first-party outcomes.

faq.question: What do SHIP, FIX, BLOCK, and UNDECIDED mean?
faq.answer: They indicate readiness, required remediation, verified blocking failures, or insufficient evidence for a supported decision.
